LoRA 测试仪 – 多通道比较工作流程

介绍LoRA 测试仪 V1，旨在测试 LoRA 的工作流程更快、更简单、更高效.

✨ 主要特点：

  • 6个并行通道→ 使用相同的提示同时比较最多六个 LoRA。

  • 非常适合测试不同的艺术风格、人物或背景并排。

  • 内置LoRA经理集成以实现平稳处理和快速切换。

  • 节省时间并帮助您找到LoRA完美匹配为您的项目。

此工作流程非常适合想要实现以下目标的创作者：
✔️ 比较同一概念的不同风格 LoRA
✔️ 尝试多个角色 LoRA
✔️ 快速预览以背景为中心的 LoRA

无论您是在微调风格还是在寻找新角色，LoRA 测试仪 V1为您提供一种清晰、结构化的方式来立即查看结果。

LoRAs Tester – Multi-Channel Comparison Workflow

IntroducingLoRAs Tester V1, a workflow designed to make testing LoRAsfaster, easier, and more efficient.

✨ Key Features:

  • 6 parallel channels→ compare up to six LoRAs at once with the same prompt.

  • Perfect for testingdifferent art styles, characters, or backgroundsside by side.

  • Built withLoRA Managerintegration for smooth handling and quick switching.

  • Saves time and helps you find theperfect LoRA matchfor your projects.

This workflow is ideal for creators who want to:
✔️ Compare different stylistic LoRAs on the same concept
✔️ Experiment with multiple character LoRAs
✔️ Quickly preview background-focused LoRAs

Whether you’re fine-tuning styles or scouting new characters, theLoRAs Tester V1gives you a clear, structured way to see results instantly.
